dataset: PlantVillage (repository-reported; source datasets are not included)
method: Frozen-backbone feature extraction + trained classifier head, exported to ONNX
validation_metric_note: This is the accuracy reported by the original repository; the train/validation images are not bundled, so the metric cannot be independently reproduced from this ZIP.
scope_warning: Closed-set classifier with no unknown class. It always ranks among the 38 supported crop/disease labels and may misclassify unsupported crops, unrelated images, and real-world field photos. It is not a general plant-species identifier or a confirmed diagnosis.
notes: int8 dynamic quantization shrank the model to 1.27 MB but collapsed accuracy to 2.8% (unsupported op handling), so the fp32 model is shipped. Static quantization with calibration data is a planned next step.
